title: The Empty Birdcage
scene: At 1:50 PM, the shop prize finch vanished. A storm kept the front shutters down from 1:30 to 2:10.

suspects.name: Iris Pike
suspects.testimony: I was feeding the other birds at 1:50 behind the counter.
suspects.alibiProof: The counter camera shows Iris with the feed tin at 1:49.

suspects.name: Jasper Vale
suspects.testimony: I was in the stockroom at 1:50, counting seed bags.
suspects.contradiction: The stock tally was last signed at 1:20, and finch feathers stuck to Jasper's sweater.

suspects.name: Kayla Nath
suspects.testimony: I was at the front window at 1:50, watching the storm.
suspects.alibiProof: The window camera shows Kayla at 1:47 and 1:53.

suspects.name: Lionel Reed
suspects.testimony: I was examining a parrot in the back room at 1:50.
suspects.alibiProof: The exam log shows Lionel's entry at 1:44 and exit at 1:56.
